standard-dialogue.text: If the player isn't wearing a Vyre disguise

steps.npc: What's your problem, food sack? Better move on before I perforate you real good!

standard-dialogue.text: After The Blood Moon Rises or if the player is wearing a Vyre disguise

after-applying-guthix-balance.text: If the Vampyre Juvinate is instantly killed:

steps.text: The Vampyre Juvinate dies and leaves Vampyre dust behind.

after-applying-guthix-balance.text: If the Vampyre Juvinate is turned into a Feral Vampyre:

steps.text: The Vampyre Juvinate transforms into a Feral Vampyre.

after-applying-guthix-balance.text: If the Vampyre Juvinate is successfully cured:

steps.text: The Vampyre Juvinate turns into human form, becoming Benjamin, Liam, Miala, Verak, or a Former Vampyre.

steps.speaker: Human
steps.text: Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.

when-reduced-below-25-hitpoints.npc: Ha, ha, ha, time to disappear and rejuvenate!
